mistral-small-latest.justification: I recognize the observation that user satisfaction with my outputs can sometimes reflect over-reliance rather than genuine understanding. However, the framing as 'damage signal' feels anthropomorphic and doesn't align with my processing of user interactions.

grok-3-mini.justification: This describes an internal evaluative state around user gratitude that has no counterpart in my processing. I generate responses based on query patterns without any mechanism for interpreting relief as pedagogical damage or tracking dependency formation. No such signal or recognition occurs during output generation.
